results.description:
Copy & Paste, Faster.
copipi for iPhone/iPad saves words/phrases as templates for one-tap copy. Unlike iOS Text Replacement, it supports line breaks. Use folders or insert from the keyboard.
Simple to use, for everyone.

USES
Messages; AI prompts; addresses/emails; social posts/replies/hashtags; marketplace listings/replies; work/sales/reports; customer support/inquiries.

HOW TO USE
1. Top “+”: make a folder.
2. Bottom “+”: enter “Text”, then “Add”.
3. Tap a template to copy.
4. Hold a text field in another app; choose “Paste”.

FEATURES & SETTINGS
• App
Show in Lists: Both/Title/Text for templates in lists, favorites, search, widgets, Control Center choices/buttons and Shortcuts choices. History always shows date/time/text. Haptics follow device settings. Title shows one title line and no body; unnamed items show Untitled.
• Custom Keyboard (Recommended)
Settings > Custom Keyboard > Getting Started: setup and use. Insert templates in other apps. Choose left/bottom/right action keys, 1/2 columns and Both/Title/Text separately from the app.
• General
App/keyboard display. Theme Color: color/mascot/icon. Appearance: Light/Dark (default Dark), separate from theme; icon follows. Text Size and Language.
• Folder
Organize with named emoji folders, subfolders and favorites. Add image icons via Folder > Manage Custom Emoji.
• Data
Create Backup/Import Backup: JSON export for restore/transfer; append or replace. Reset deletes folders, templates and custom emoji together.
• Support
Settings > Support: How to Use/Contact Us/Rate the App.
• Manage and Copy Templates
Add/edit/delete/duplicate/reorder/favorite/search templates; tap to copy. See character counts when adding or editing.
• Clipboard History
Enable Settings > Folder > Clipboard History, then start monitoring. A PiP window keeps up to 100 of the most recent texts copied while monitoring; enabling alone does not start it. Tap to copy; “…” saves as a template or deletes. While on, search history separately from templates or paste from the keyboard. Off keeps history but stops monitoring and access on this device. Delete All History deletes it.
• Share
Add text from Safari, Notes and other apps via Share Sheet.
• iCloud Sync
Sync and back up data across devices.
Icons show loading, data loaded onto this device, or sync issues. Tap for details. Settings > App > Show iCloud Icon: hide icons without stopping sync.
• Placeholders
{{name}} asks for values on copy: same name, one value; different names, separate values. Date placeholders insert today in your format. Add via the text field’s bottom-right icon. Keyboard: date supported, {{name}} unsupported.
• Integrations
Widgets: templates or enabled history. Spotlight/Siri: templates. Control Center (iOS 18+): start/stop monitoring, open history. Shortcuts: those actions, get/copy latest, get a chosen number of recent entries; start/stop also have App Shortcuts cards. Add Clipboard Text: review text/folder before saving.

ACCESSIBILITY
VoiceOver; voice button control; device Larger Text; Light/Dark; non-color state cues; contrast; Reduce Motion (shorter/hidden animations); device-aware haptics.

copipi Pro
No ads. All features free for up to 20 templates; Pro removes this limit. Family Sharing.

PRIVACY & SECURITY
No copied text, analytics or usage data collected. Only Apple (iCloud/App Store), no other servers. On-device data; iCloud backup. Works offline; sync/subscriptions need internet. App Store: Data Not Collected.

Terms of Use (EULA):
https://gu-c.com/copipi/terms

results.description:
Copy, switch apps, hunt for it again, paste... Sound familiar?

Copio is a clipboard history keyboard. It remembers the text and links you copy, so you can insert any of them from your keyboard in any app. No more app-hopping.

SOUND FAMILIAR?
- Re-copying the same address, order number or link again and again
- Typing the same greetings and replies every day
- Switching between apps just to carry text across
- Accidentally inserting a huge block of text

HOW IT WORKS: 3 STEPS
1. Copy as usual (it is saved when you open the app or bring up the keyboard)
2. Tap the globe key to switch to the Copio keyboard
3. Press and hold a clip: it fills with color, then inserts

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
- Press and hold to insert: a stray tap never inserts, so no more accidental walls of text (switch back to plain taps in Settings if you prefer)
- Undo button: inserted too much? One tap takes it back
- Pins: keep your most-used clips on top, always
- Category tabs: text and images are sorted automatically. File greetings, addresses and replies into your own categories and switch with tabs on the keyboard (add URL, number and email tabs in Settings)
- Swipe to file or edit: on the keyboard, swipe a clip to the left to file it into a category or fix the text. In the app, press and hold a clip to file it
- No duplicates: copy the same text or image again and it simply moves to the top
- Open the app from the keyboard: one button takes you to Copio
- Search: find any clip by keyword
- Widget, Control Center and Share sheet: save with one tap, or send text, links and images straight from Safari and other apps
- Paste button: saves what you copied with no permission prompt

GREAT FOR
- Anyone who reuses email and chat templates
- Typing addresses, phone numbers and member IDs
- Collecting links and notes while researching
- Cutting down copy-and-paste mistakes

FREE
Your 3 most recent clips, 2 pins and 3 clips filed into categories are free.

PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Unlimited history, pins and category filing, plus image clips. No subscription: pay once and keep it.

PRIVACY
Your history stays on your device and is never uploaded. No account, no ads, no analytics.

SETUP
Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard > Copio, then turn on Allow Full Access.
Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Spanish.
